yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:

  title: Closing Statement
  description: Closing Statement contract normalized from the DocuBricks Real estate library.
  version: real_estate_closing_statement_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: real_estate/closing_statement
    sourcePath: Schemas/real_estate/closing_statement
    sourceVersion: real_estate_closing_statement_v1
    sourceDigest: a91dd7c9e3b632074e2050a4b438b82cc4685f10a03ab525bd9b03382b395dda
spec:
  documentType: closing_statement
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - closing-date
        - closing-statement-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - recording-reference
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - loan-amount
        - purchase-price
    - id: line-items
      title: Line Items
      description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - payoffs
        - prorations
        - title-charges
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - buyer-cash-to-close
        - buyer-name
        - seller-name
        - seller-proceeds
        - settlement-agent-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - property-address
  fields:
    - id: closing-statement-date
      name: closing_statement_date
      label: Closing Statement Date
      description: Closing statement date.
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/closing_statement_date
    - id: property-address
      name: property_address
      label: Property Address
      description: Property address.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/property_address
    - id: buyer-name
      name: buyer_name
      label: Buyer Name
      description: Buyer name.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/buyer_name
    - id: seller-name
      name: seller_name
      label: Seller Name
      description: Seller name.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/seller_name
    - id: settlement-agent-name
      name: settlement_agent_name
      label: Settlement Agent Name
      description: Settlement agent, title company, or escrow officer.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/settlement_agent_name
    - id: closing-date
      name: closing_date
      label: Closing Date
      description: Closing date.
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/closing_date
    - id: purchase-price
      name: purchase_price
      label: Purchase Price
      description: Purchase price.
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/purchase_price
    - id: loan-amount
      name: loan_amount
      label: Loan Amount
      description: Loan proceeds or loan amount.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/loan_amount
    - id: buyer-cash-to-close
      name: buyer_cash_to_close
      label: Buyer Cash To Close
      description: Buyer cash to close.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/buyer_cash_to_close
    - id: seller-proceeds
      name: seller_proceeds
      label: Seller Proceeds
      description: Seller net proceeds.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/seller_proceeds
    - id: prorations
      name: prorations
      label: Prorations
      description: Tax, rent, utility, CAM, or other prorations.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/prorations
    - id: title-charges
      name: title_charges
      label: Title Charges
      description: Title, escrow, recording, transfer tax, or settlement charges.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/title_charges
    - id: payoffs
      name: payoffs
      label: Payoffs
      description: Mortgage, lien, or other payoff items.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/payoffs
    - id: recording-reference
      name: recording_reference
      label: Recording Reference
      description: Recording information if stated.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/recording_reference
  validationRules:
    - id: closing-statement-date-present
      severity: error
      description: closing_statement_date is required for Closing Statement extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: closing_statement_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: closing_statement_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: closing_statement_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(closing_statement_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: property-address-present
      severity: error
      description: property_address is required for Closing Statement extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: property_address
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: property_address
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: property_address IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(property_address)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: buyer-name-present
      severity: error
      description: buyer_name is required for Closing Statement extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: buyer_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: buyer_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: buyer_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(buyer_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: seller-name-present
      severity: error
      description: seller_name is required for Closing Statement extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: seller_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: seller_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: seller_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(seller_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: closing-date-present
      severity: error
      description: closing_date is required for Closing Statement extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: closing_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: closing_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: closing_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(closing_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: purchase-price-present
      severity: error
      description: purchase_price is required for Closing Statement extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: purchase_price
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: purchase_price
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: purchase_price IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(purchase_price)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: purchase-price-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: purchase_price should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: purchase_price
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: purchase_price
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: purchase_price IS NULL OR purchase_price >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: loan-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: loan_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: loan_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: loan_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: loan_amount IS NULL OR loan_amount >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: buyer-cash-to-close-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: buyer_cash_to_close should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: buyer_cash_to_close
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: buyer_cash_to_close
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: buyer_cash_to_close IS NULL OR buyer_cash_to_close >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: seller-proceeds-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: seller_proceeds should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: seller_proceeds
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: seller_proceeds
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: seller_proceeds IS NULL OR seller_proceeds >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      property_address:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Closing Statement workflow.
      buyer_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Closing Statement workflow.
      seller_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Closing Statement workflow.
      closing_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Closing Statement workflow.
      purchase_price:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Closing Statement workflow.
      closing_statement_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Closing Statement workflow.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Closing Statement documents combine real estate parties, property, title, lease, financial, and
      operating context.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      closing_statement_date:
        type: date
        description: Closing statement date.
        format: date
      property_address:
        type: string
        description: Property address.
      buyer_name:
        type: string
        description: Buyer name.
      seller_name:
        type: string
        description: Seller name.
      settlement_agent_name:
        type: string
        description: Settlement agent, title company, or escrow officer.
      closing_date:
        type: date
        description: Closing date.
        format: date
      purchase_price:
        type: number
        description: Purchase price.
      loan_amount:
        type: number
        description: Loan proceeds or loan amount.
      buyer_cash_to_close:
        type: number
        description: Buyer cash to close.
      seller_proceeds:
        type: number
        description: Seller net proceeds.
      prorations:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            item:
              type: string
              description: Proration item.
            party_credited:
              type: string
              description: Credited party.
            party_debited:
              type: string
              description: Debited party.
            amount:
              type: number
              description: Proration amount.
        description: Tax, rent, utility, CAM, or other prorations.
      title_charges:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            item:
              type: string
              description: Title or settlement charge item.
            amount:
              type: number
              description: Charge amount.
            paid_by:
              type: string
              description: Party responsible for charge.
        description: Title, escrow, recording, transfer tax, or settlement charges.
      payoffs:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            payee:
              type: string
              description: Payoff recipient.
            amount:
              type: number
              description: Payoff amount.
            reference:
              type: string
              description: Loan, lien, or account reference.
        description: Mortgage, lien, or other payoff items.
      recording_reference:
        type: string
        description: Recording information if stated.
    required:
      - closing_statement_date
      - property_address
      - buyer_name
      - seller_name
      - closing_date
      - purchase_price
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: real_estate_transactions
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - closing_statement_date
          - property_address
          - buyer_name
          - seller_name
          - closing_date
          - purchase_price
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - line_items
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields:
          - prorations
          - title_charges
          - payoffs
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
